brainlife.desc: Stimulus aperture movie (NIfTI, pixels x pixels x time, values 0-1) shown during a retinotopy BOLD run.
brainlife.name: neuro/stimulus
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Stimulus input to pRF model fitting (AFNI, analyzePRF, mrTools).

**Not for:** Runs whose number of frames differs from the BOLD volumes.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 1 (aggregated, non-revealing) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 5 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.stimulus.json
